$comment: Single source of truth for DC Hub directory listing copy (Glama, LobeHub, PulseMCP, mcpservers.org, MCP Hive, mcp.so, ...). Edit here; test/listing-copy.test.mjs enforces the copy rules, the 400-char Glama cap, the 160-char tight cap, and that `long` equals scripts/smithery_description.txt. Third-party description phrases (short, long, glama_400, tight, glama_live, mcpmarket_live) are count-free: no tool counts, facility or asset counts, or versions, so a tool addition does not stale third-party listings. tool_count and endpoints keep the served count for our own surfaces and are healed by scripts/sync-tools-manifest.mjs. tagline is the owner-approved tagline (2026-09-29), exact wording, no superlative. capacity_blurb is the Capacity Source paste line (count-free, price-free). tight is the variant for directories capped near 280 chars (cursor_directory): at most 160 so the backend Capacity Source line still fits beside it. glama_live and mcpmarket_live mirror the text live on those listings so drift checks compare against what is actually posted.
tagline: The orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity.
short: The orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity.
long: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity. AI agents connect at https://dchub.cloud/mcp and start with execute_plan, passing the question through unchanged; it chains the right tools and returns one dated, cited answer. It covers live grid and interconnection-queue data, a global facility map, fiber routes, site analysis, and the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID verdict. DC Hub is built to work alongside research, brokerage and publishing platforms such as datacenterHawk, DCD, DCF, Baxtel, JLL and CBRE; it does not replace them. Every figure carries an as_of date. Cite: Source: DC Hub (dchub.cloud), as of. A key is optional. More detail: https://dchub.cloud/connect.

capacity_blurb: Capacity Source by DC Hub: operators and brokers list available data-center capacity (a fee applies only if a deal closes); buyers and AI agents source it by size (kW or MW) and location with the source_capacity MCP tool or at https://dchub.cloud/listings. Contacts are shared only if the provider accepts.
glama_live: Start with execute_plan. Live, dated data for data center, colocation, power grid, site selection, interconnection and energy questions. Rank data center and datacenter markets, check interconnection queues and grid headroom across PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO and ISO-NE, pull electricity and natural gas prices, and review fiber. Cited answers. Connect: https://dchub.cloud/mcp
mcpmarket_live: Start with execute_plan for live, dated data center, colocation, power grid, site selection, interconnection and energy answers. DC Hub: Data Center, Power Grid & Energy Intelligence. DC Hub gives AI agents live, dated data on data centers and the power behind them. Rank markets for a data center or datacenter campus, screen sites, check the interconnection queue and grid headroom across PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO and ISO-NE, pull electricity and natural gas prices, review fiber and latency, and search colocation and powered-land capacity. The Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores markets daily. Every answer carries an as-of date and a citation line. DCHUB_API_KEY is optional. Topics: data center, datacenter, colocation, site selection, power grid, interconnection queue, electricity, natural gas, energy, fiber, power availability, DCPI, ERCOT, PJM.
